黑风剑客很清瘦，和本尊差不多，只是面庞多出几分‘阴’郁，年龄约莫二十三四岁。

一众天尊惊怒交加，虽然他们和时空凶兽一族的天尊没什么深厚的交情，但毕竟都是同层次的强者。现如今光明天尊丧心病狂，竟然以天尊为祭，谁知道会不会对他们下手。

这些老前辈一个个都是前辈高人，既然能曲解他一次，就肯定还能曲解他第二次。

除此之外，大夏那边还传来了别的好消息，天虫武帝没有让李恒轩失望。

上坂堇和花泽香菜一样，也是一名声优，同样也是灌篮高手的粉丝。

周彤询问了一下如何说服的，穆浩直言都不用说服，一提出五人独立进攻旬江城，田白岩就立即提出可以支持，三徒顺势提出借用禁锢空间之物，田白岩二话不说的拿出一套三才定宇符交给三人。

众人方才还半信半疑，胡灵娜的强势由来已久，这个敢找上门来的人也不是善茬，事情的真伪还并非信口一说大家就真相信，可是看了视频，在看到陈三本人他们算是彻底明白了。

王斌心中紧张起来，心想原本李阳就和青龙帮有过节，此刻过来的显然是这个地下组织精锐中的精锐，他们和李阳对上，还有枪，李阳该怎么办？

下一刻，那淡淡的光泽竟形成一个和他长得一模一样的元神，然后消失在了空气之中。

“那宁昊天破坏我赤霄峰呢？我想之前你们都在暗中观察吧。”江辰问道。

卓雄无奈，只得退下来跟大家说明了情况。机关这种东西，在古代建筑里很常见，就比如这座玲珑宝塔，其在建筑设计上的造诣可谓是登峰造极，后人想要复制是不可能的了。

那两尊宿敌在天皇道尊的脑海中，依然的年轻、意气风发，神伟超然。

The Black Wind Swordsman is very thin, similar to the original figure, but his face is a bit more gloomy, and he is about twenty-three or four years old.

All the Heavenly Lords were shocked and angry. Although they did not have a deep friendship with the Heavenly Lords from the Space-Time Beast Clan, they were all powerful men at the same level after all.Now Guangming Tianzun is so crazy that he even sacrifices Tianzun. Who knows if he will attack them.

Each of these seniors are senior experts. Since they can misunderstand him once, they can definitely misunderstand him a second time.

In addition, there was other good news from Daxia. Emperor Tian Chong Wu did not disappoint Li Hengxuan.

Sumire Uesaka, like Hanazawa Kana, is also a voice actress and a fan of Slam Dunk.

Zhou Tong asked how to persuade, but Mu Hao said that he didn't need to be persuaded. As soon as Tian Baiyan proposed that five people attack Xunjiang City independently, Tian Baiyan immediately offered to support it. The three disciples took advantage of the situation and offered to borrow the object of confining space. Tian Baiyan took out a set of Sancai Dingyu Talisman and handed it to the three of them without saying a word.

Everyone was half-convinced just now. Hu Lingna has been strong for a long time, and this person who dared to come to her door was not a good person. The truth of the matter was not something that everyone really believed just by saying it. But after watching the video and seeing Chen San herself, they finally understood.

Wang Bin became nervous, thinking that Li Yang originally had a problem with the Qinglong Gang, and now those who came over were obviously the elite of this underground organization. They faced off against Li Yang, and they also had guns. What should Li Yang do?

The next moment, the faint luster formed into a soul that looked exactly like him, and then disappeared into the air.

"What about Ning Haotian destroying my Chixiao Peak? I think you were all secretly observing before." Jiang Chen asked.

Zhuo Xiong had no choice but to step back and explain the situation to everyone.Mechanisms are very common in ancient buildings. For example, this exquisite pagoda has reached the pinnacle of architectural design. It is impossible for future generations to copy it.

In the mind of Emperor Dao Zun, those two old enemies are still young, energetic, and majestic.
